description: In combination with `histSST`, quantifies the transient tropospheric ozone effective radiative forcing (ERF) over the historical period. Same as `histSST`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) emissions are held at 1850 values, and methane is held at 1850 values in the chemistry scheme only (it evolves as in `histSST` in the radiation scheme). Atmosphere-only counterpart of `hist-piO3`.
branch_information: Branch from `piControl` at a time of your choosing
